# Meetings

Manage meetings in Teamleader Focus Calendar.

```php
Teamleader::meetings()
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Class | `McoreServices\TeamleaderSDK\Resources\Calendar\Meetings` |
| Create / update / delete | ✓ / ✓ / ✓ |
| Pagination | `page_size` / `page_number`; no totals — a short page is the last one |

## Endpoints

- `meetings.complete`
- `meetings.createReport`
- `meetings.delete`
- `meetings.info`
- `meetings.list`
- `meetings.schedule`
- `meetings.update`

## Filters

Passed as the first argument to `list()`. Any other key throws.

| Filter | Description |
|---|---|
| `employee_id` | Filter by assigned employee UUID |
| `end_date` | Filter meetings up to this date (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `group_id` | Filter by nextgen project group UUID (cannot be combined with milestone_id) |
| `ids` | Array of meeting UUIDs to filter by |
| `milestone_id` | Filter by legacy project milestone UUID (cannot be combined with group_id) |
| `recurrence_id` | Filter by recurring meeting series UUID |
| `start_date` | Filter meetings from this date (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `term` | Search meetings by title or description |

## Sorting

Pass `sort` (and optionally `sort_order`) in the options. Any other field throws.

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `scheduled_at` | Scheduled start |

## Includes

`list()` and `info()` accept the same includes:

`estimated_time`, `tracked_time`

## Accepted values

Public constants on the class. Body fields and enum values outside these lists
throw before the request is sent.

| Constant | Values |
|---|---|
| `ATTENDEE_TYPES` | `user`, `contact` |
| `CUSTOMER_TYPES` | `contact`, `company` |
| `INCLUDES` | `tracked_time`, `estimated_time` |
| `REPORT_FIELDS` | `attach_to`, `summary`, `custom_fields` |
| `REPORT_TARGET_TYPES` | `contact`, `company`, `deal` |
| `REQUIRED_ON_SCHEDULE` | `title`, `starts_at`, `ends_at`, `attendees` |
| `SCHEDULE_FIELDS` | `title`, `starts_at`, `ends_at`, `description`, `attendees`, `customer`, `location`, `project_id`, `group_id`, `milestone_id`, `deal_id`, `work_order_id`, `custom_fields` |
| `UPDATE_FIELDS` | `title`, `starts_at`, `ends_at`, `description`, `attendees`, `customer`, `location`, `project_id`, `group_id`, `milestone_id`, `deal_id`, `custom_fields` |

## Methods

### `list()`

```php
list(array $filters = [], array $options = []): array
```

List meetings

- `$filters` — ids, employee_id, start_date, end_date, milestone_id, group_id, term, recurrence_id. group_id (nextgen project group) cannot be combined with milestone_id (legacy).
- `$options` — page_size, page_number, sort (scheduled_at), sort_order, include(s)

**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException` On an unknown filter key, option, sort field or include

### `info()`

```php
info($id, $includes = null): array
```

Get one meeting

- `$id` — Meeting UUID
- `$includes` — tracked_time and/or estimated_time

**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException` On an include meetings.info does not accept

### `schedule()`

```php
schedule(array $data): array
```

Schedule a meeting

Requires title, starts_at, ends_at and attendees, with at least one user
attendee. `customer` is optional; until v2.2.12 the SDK required it.

project_id and milestone_id are mutually exclusive, and group_id
requires project_id.

**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException` When a required field is missing, or a field or value is not accepted

### `update()`

```php
update($id, array $data): array
```

Update a meeting

If attendees is given it must include at least one user. customer,
description, deal_id, project_id, group_id and milestone_id take null
to clear them.

**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException` When a field or value is not accepted

### `delete()`

```php
delete($id, ...$additionalParams): array
```

Delete a meeting

### `complete()`


Mark meeting as complete

## Examples

Get list of meetings with filtering:

```php
$meetings = Teamleader::meetings()->list(['employee_id' => 'employee-uuid']);
```

Get meeting details with tracked time:

```php
$meeting = Teamleader::meetings()->withTrackedTime()->info('meeting-uuid');
```

Schedule a new meeting:

```php
$meeting = Teamleader::meetings()->schedule([...]);
```

Mark a meeting as complete:

```php
Teamleader::meetings()->complete('meeting-uuid');
```

Create a report for completed meeting:

```php
$report = Teamleader::meetings()->createReport('meeting-uuid', [...]);
```
